taiwan_aviation.headline: 中國東方航空 A330-300 抵桃園　本站180天未見同組合
taiwan_aviation.summary: 公開 ADS-B 觀測資料顯示，中國東方航空一架 Airbus A330-300 於 2026 年 11 月 27 日抵達臺灣桃園國際機場（TPE）。本站監測系統記錄的確認抵達時間為 06:10:12 UTC，紀錄所列機場 ICAO 代碼為 RCTP。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: China Eastern Airlines A330-300 Arrives at Taoyuan; Site Had No Matching Combination in 180 Days
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Public ADS-B data monitored by the site show a China Eastern Airlines Airbus A330-300 arriving at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) on Nov. 27, 2026. The system recorded the arrival confirmation at 06:10:12 UTC. The airport's ICAO code is RCTP.

international_aviation.headline: 俄羅斯軍事法院裁定羈押空天軍副司令格列霍夫
international_aviation.summary: 俄羅斯《生意人報》查閱法院紀錄後報導，莫斯科第235衛戍軍事法院11月25日批准調查人員的聲請，裁定羈押俄羅斯空天軍負責裝備的副司令格列霍夫。
international_aviation.headline_en: Russian military court orders detention of Aerospace Forces deputy chief Grekhov
international_aviation.summary_en: Kommersant reported that Moscow’s 235th Garrison Military Court granted investigators’ request to hold Yuri Grekhov in pretrial detention on November 25. He is the Russian Aerospace Forces deputy commander-in-chief responsible for armaments.

international_aviation.headline: Norse Atlantic暫停11月26日所有航班
international_aviation.summary: Norse Atlantic表示，若無法緊急取得短期融資方案，董事會打算聲請破產。該公司11月25日曾警告，財務狀況「危急」。
international_aviation.headline_en: Norse Atlantic suspends all flights scheduled for November 26
international_aviation.summary_en: Norse Atlantic said its board intended to file for bankruptcy if a short-term financing solution was not secured urgently. On November 25, the airline had warned that its financial situation was ‘critical’.

international_aviation.headline: 巴基斯坦國際航空改用自有777 恢復英國航班
international_aviation.summary: 巴基斯坦國際航空11月26日宣佈恢復英國航班，改以自有波音777機隊執飛。此前，提供飛機及機組的 Norse Atlantic 暫停代飛，導致11月25日自倫敦和曼徹斯特起飛的兩班航班取消。
international_aviation.headline_en: PIA restores UK flights using its own Boeing 777 fleet
international_aviation.summary_en: Pakistan International Airlines said on November 26 that it had restored UK services using its own Boeing 777 fleet, Reuters reported. A suspension by its wet-lease partner Norse Atlantic forced the cancellation of two flights from London and Manchester a day earlier.

international_aviation.headline: 荷蘭皇家航空2027年夏季班表暫未列阿姆斯特丹至澤西航班
international_aviation.summary: 截至11月26日，荷蘭皇家航空的2027年夏季班表未列阿姆斯特丹史基浦機場（AMS）至澤西機場（JER）的航班。該媒體已向航空公司詢問是否永久退出，仍待回覆。
international_aviation.headline_en: KLM’s summer 2027 schedule currently shows no Amsterdam–Jersey flights
international_aviation.summary_en: As of November 26, KLM’s summer 2027 timetable did not list flights between Amsterdam Schiphol (AMS) and Jersey, Simple Flying reported. The publication said it had asked the airline whether the withdrawal was permanent.

international_aviation.headline: 西南航空2026年最長737橫貫美國航線出爐 波士頓—舊金山2704英里居首
international_aviation.summary: 西南航空以737機隊經營全美最大的國內窄體航網，雖然外界多半將其與中短程航線聯想在一起，但部分航線橫跨美國本土、逼近2700英里。根據Cirium的2026年數據，該公司最長的橫貫航線是波士頓洛根—舊金山，平均2704英里；第二名是羅德島T.F.格林—舊金山，平均2691英里；第三名是波士頓—聖荷西，平均2689英里，前三名之間僅差15英里。
international_aviation.headline_en: Southwest's longest transcontinental Boeing 737 routes in 2026 led by Boston–San Francisco at 2,704 miles
international_aviation.summary_en: Southwest Airlines operates one of the largest domestic narrowbody networks in the US, and although the carrier is usually associated with short- and medium-haul flying, several of its routes stretch nearly 2,700 miles across the continental United States. According to Cirium data for 2026, its longest route connects Boston Logan International Airport (BOS) with San Francisco International Airport (SFO), covering an average of 2,704 miles. Rhode Island T.F. Green International Airport–San Francisco is second at 2,691 miles, and Boston–San Jose International Airport is third at 2,689 miles — just 15 miles separate the longest and third-longest services.
entities: Rhode Island T.F. Green International Airport
